OOF_RBF_omitted: Single natural series does not provide independent episodes; no artificial episode folds

analysis.failures: stop on unexpected numerical/data failure; preserve attempted rows; no replacement or post-hoc common-support claim
analysis.primary: SMSE: each horizon MSE / full-A corresponding target population variance floored at1e-12; horizons equally weighted; series equally within frequency; frequencies equally overall
analysis.sampling_unit: series; 32 origins and3 horizons are dependent repeated measurements
analysis.secondary: study-specific seasonal MASE with A-only lag52 Weekly/24 Hourly scale and frequency MASE lag1 Weekly/24 Hourly; both floored at1e-12; neither is official full-horizon M4 evaluation
analysis.uncertainty: descriptive only; no independent-series CI, p-value, or population generalization

chronology: 12 intervening origins purged between A/B/C/D; previous max-horizon target strictly earlier than next first origin; D outcomes released after prediction seal

direct_controls.drift: At each origin y_t + h*(y_t-y_start)/(t-start), start=earliest history observation used by A

execution.affinity: workers share allowed CPU indices[3:6] when available; otherwise retain current allowed set

extra_rbf.interpretation: bounded centered Nystrom RBF slope on the same full-A in-sample residuals and shared common+B bias; bandwidth factors multiply median squared reference distance

selection: same B selection/C calibration and calibrated-C family choice as simulation; no post-C refit
status: external benchmark-development evidence; no public preregistration or independent-source inference
